cases.name: vm
cases.yaml:
---
apiVersion: orbivisor.io/v1
kind: Vm
metadata:
  name: web01
  folder: /prod/web
  labels:
    orbivisor.io/apply-set: web-prod
    tier: front end
  annotations:
    orbivisor.io/prune: "false"
spec:
  vcpus: 4
  memory_mib: 8192
  cpu:
    model: x86-64-v2
    flags: []
  disks:
    - volume: web01-disk0
      bus: virtio
      boot_order: 1
  nics:
    - network: lan
      mac: "52:54:00:12:34:56"
      security_groups:
        - web
        - ssh
  cloud_init:
    user: ubuntu
    password:
      secretRef: web01-password
    ssh_keys: []
  description: ""
  ha: null
  tpm: false
state: running
